categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Everbright Measurement And Control Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the railway-specific equipment manufacturing sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of rail safety measurement and control equipment and related technical solutions. Its product portfolio includes rail geometry state detection systems, value transfer systems, comprehensive intelligent detection systems, rail line inspection systems, power supply maintenance systems, and rail maintenance tools and services. The company also provides precise rail measurement and adjustment services throughout the rail lifecycle, serving both new construction and maintenance of existing lines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as 'star control + pile control' integrated rail measurement and control technology, inertial navigation combined with total station and satellite positioning for rail inspection, and intelligent software for data fusion and simulation-based rail adjustment. Its products integrate hardware and software with core algorithms developed in-house, emphasizing high precision, digital measurement, and intelligent operation. Production involves self-managed parts processing, assembly, and rigorous static and dynamic testing to meet industry standards and customer requirements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include the China State Railway Group and its 18 regional railway bureaus, local railway companies, engineering construction units, and urban rail transit operators. The company serves the national railway market, including high-speed and conventional railways, and the urban rail transit market encompassing metros and light rail systems. Its products and services support rail construction, acceptance, daily maintenance, and major repairs, addressing the entire rail lifecycle.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in regions including Northeast, North China, East China, Northwest, Southwest, and Central South China. It serves national railway bureaus and urban rail transit systems across these regions. There is no significant mention of overseas operations, indicating a domestic focus.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Everbright Measurement And Control Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the rail industry supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of specialized rail measurement and control equipment. It also provides downstream technical services such as precise rail measurement and adjustment. The company is a key equipment and technology supplier to railway operators and construction entities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in rail measurement and control technologies, focusing on integrating satellite positioning (Beidou), inertial navigation, and intelligent data fusion for enhanced rail safety and maintenance efficiency. R&D priorities include expanding product lines like rapid absolute measurement instruments, large machine operation software, contact network measurement devices, and comprehensive rapid detection systems. It maintains high R&D investment (~10% of revenue), holds numerous patents, and collaborates with research institutes and universities to strengthen technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of rail safety measurement equipment and related products, as well as through service contracts for precise rail measurement and adjustment operations. The company recognizes product sales revenue upon customer acceptance and payment obligation, while service revenues are recognized progressively based on contract completion. Additional income includes government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider in the rail safety measurement and control sector, recognized as a key player with strong R&D capabilities, proprietary technologies, and comprehensive service offerings. The industry has high entry barriers due to technical requirements and certification standards. The company competes by leveraging its technological advantages, stable customer relationships, and compliance with national rail equipment standards.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 160.7 million, a 4.21% increase from 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 75.3 million, up 24.22%. Total assets reached about RMB 1.008 billion, with shareholders' equity of RMB 904 million. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with increasing cash flow from operations and sustained R&D investment. It has a solid financial base with a low asset-liability ratio (~10.33%).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-precision, integrated rail safety measurement and control solutions that cover the entire rail lifecycle, from new line construction to maintenance and overhaul. Its products combine advanced measurement technologies with intelligent software, enabling efficient, accurate, and comprehensive rail condition monitoring and adjustment. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, compliance with national standards, and a mature service system, ensuring reliability, safety, and cost-effectiveness for customers.
